Y.name: Young learner
Y.evidence: Gets most questions right again a week later and can show the idea with objects or drawings.

T.name: Theory
T.evidence: Two independent cumulative attempts near 85%, with sound reasoning and repaired prerequisites.

W.name: Reading and writing
W.evidence: A clear, supported piece of writing on an unseen prompt, and accurate analysis of an unseen text.

L.name: Laboratory science
L.evidence: Two cumulative attempts near 85%, plus a lab report with data, uncertainty and a defensible conclusion.

J.name: Legal analysis
J.evidence: Two exam-style cumulative attempts near 80% on unseen questions, and written analyses that spot the issues, state the rules accurately and apply them to the facts.

D.name: Drafting and advocacy
D.evidence: A complete, well-organized written or oral product on an unseen problem that a supervising lawyer could use with minor edits.
